message:
Hey Mike,

The Rodriguez-Anzaldúa ripple must have happened before I sunk my hooks into WOR. I have copies of the fifth (1999) and sixth (2002) editions here, and both of them have Rodriguez and Anzaldúa.   Was it an earlier edition?  Did Rodriguez make it back in after an absence?

I'd never considered reading the switches as an indication that the field's regard for cultural difference was shifting.  Wonder if that has any bearing on Auster being dropped from the 5th ed. or Baldwin replacing Ellison.  I was really disappointed when WOR dumped Ellison's "Extravagance."
